alts.cuisine: Moroccan (tagines, couscous, mint tea)
alts.walkFrom: hotel (instead of the Didi to Jiujiang Road)
alts.note: On the Bund, 7 min on foot from the hotel, so the night walk starts right outside. Lamb tagine, couscous and mint tea; says halal, alcohol served. Expensive (Ctrip average CNY 388 a head) and also the New Year's Eve dinner, so only if Sumanya is closed.
